record.one_liner: Podio is a customizable work-management platform (now under Progress/ShareFile) where teams build apps, workspaces, tasks and workflows.
record.auth_notes: Four OAuth2-style flows: server-side, client-side, username/password, and app authentication (single-app, no user). Requires a client ID/secret ("API key") from account settings. Header: `Authorization: OAuth2 ACCESS_TOKEN`. Access tokens last 8 hours, refresh tokens 28 days.
record.access_notes: An API key is generated from the API key tab in a Podio account's settings. The page does not mention approval or a paid-plan requirement. I did not verify whether a free Podio plan is still offered, or what the API Terms of Use say. Rate limits exist; higher limits require contacting Podio. Figures are on /index/limits, which I did not fetch.
record.blocker: Rate limits apply and need a contact to raise. The official MCP server is in beta. The username/password flow is discouraged. I could not confirm that free accounts still exist, or the API terms. "REST" and "WebSocket" are inferred, not stated on the pages I fetched.
